children: On September 16, 2026, Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Staff issued a Staff Delisting Determination for Hub Group's Class A common stock due to failure to timely file its 2025 Form 10-K and Q1/Q2 2026 Forms 10-Q, violating Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The company will appeal, triggering an automatic 15-day stay of any trading suspension, and will seek an extended stay, though there is no assurance it will be granted.
